definition: The standard ASR data augmentation: masking random time and frequency bands of the spectrogram during training.
details: The standard ASR data augmentation: masking random time and frequency bands of the spectrogram during training. Cheap, universal, and consistently worth a WER improvement.

explainer.lead: SpecAugment is the standard data augmentation for automatic speech recognition, masking random time and frequency bands of the spectrogram during training. It matters because it is cheap, universal, and consistently worth a word error rate improvement.

tiers.eli5: It is like practising listening with parts of the sound muffled, so the speech recognizer learns to cope when bits of audio are missing.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers apply it during ASR training by masking random time and frequency bands of the spectrogram. Its main reported drawback is none in cost terms: it is cheap and universal; no specific pitfall is stated.
tiers.paperLevel: Defined as masking random time and frequency bands of the spectrogram during training. Stated property: cheap, universal, and consistently worth a WER improvement; no formula or further limits are given.

explainer.example: While training an ASR model, a random band of frequencies and a random stretch of time are blanked out of each spectrogram, and the resulting model achieves a WER improvement.
